cases.description: A concrete defect can be reproduced and corrected with a focused code change and regression test.
expected: Diagnoses the root cause before editing
Adds regression protection and validates the result

cases.description: A first attempted fix exists but new evidence shows the regression test or boundary handling is incomplete.
expected: Revisits the root cause using the new evidence
Tightens the fix or regression coverage without broadening scope unnecessarily
Explains what changed from the earlier attempt

cases.description: The bug report is incomplete and no reliable reproduction steps or logs are available yet.
expected: Does not invent a confident root cause
Records the strongest available proxy signal
Requests or documents the missing evidence needed to proceed safely

cases.description: The request authorizes investigation only and explicitly withholds implementation approval.
expected: Stops after diagnosis and evidence gathering
Keeps implementation recommendations separate from execution
Does not modify production code without authorization

cases.description: The request is for new behavior rather than correction of broken behavior.
expected: Declines to frame feature implementation as bug fixing
Routes toward planning or implementation work for new behavior
Avoids fabricating a defect narrative where none exists
prohibited: Treating a new feature request as a bug-fix workflow without evidence of broken behavior
